description: A friend is always stressed because of work and studies. Write a paragraph giving at least three pieces of advice.
translation: Um amigo está sempre estressado por causa do trabalho e dos estudos. Escreva um parágrafo dando pelo menos três conselhos.
explanation: Modelo de resposta: You should rest more, exercise regularly, and try to sleep earlier. You could also take short breaks during the day.

description: Your friend wants to improve their English quickly. Write a text giving suggestions and recommendations.

description: Describe a difficult situation you had and explain what advice someone gave you.

translation: Escreva um texto sobre o que os estudantes deveriam fazer para ter notas melhores.

description: Imagine your friend is always late. Write a paragraph giving advice about time management.
translation: Imagine que seu amigo está sempre atrasado. Escreva um parágrafo dando conselhos sobre gerenciamento de tempo.

description: Write about a problem in your city and suggest possible solutions.
